must_fix.problem: Runner hardcodes remote source, project, index, binary, generator, ledger and output paths instead of consuming frozen NANHAI_* bindings from local_env.md. This conflicts with current project AGENTS.md path authority and makes future binding drift invisible.
must_fix.required: Read and verify a frozen remote environment binding derived from local_env.md, then construct all paths from its variables; pin its hash in the reviewed packet or immutable control receipt. Preserve exact source/project isolation checks.

must_fix.problem: Live gz02 check found neither required control/generate_manifest_heads.py nor control/MANIFEST-HEADS.tsv. Current prepare() must fail before graph; their local hashes alone do not prove remote staging.
must_fix.required: Stage exact read-only copies in project control, verify their SHA256 and a fresh ledger replay, and review destination ownership/permissions before dispatch.

must_fix.problem: root_guard excludes old out and .repo, records root names and only Android.bp/bootstrap.bash of ten manifest linkfiles. Eight other generated linkfiles can change without altering the per-repo tracked ledger. Pre/post equality does not compare root state to a pinned admitted baseline. Untracked guard counts paths but not their bytes; its zero baseline is currently sound only while nobody write isolation and no concurrent writer are proven.
must_fix.required: Pin and recheck all ten manifest link destinations, targets and content hashes plus root topology; record explicit exclusions for old out/.repo.failed and verify prune marker/permissions. Keep an immediate pre/post no-untracked check and detect permission drift. Do not label whole shared source unchanged beyond these guards.

must_fix.problem: Outer group termination is only inside except subprocess.TimeoutExpired. KeyboardInterrupt, signal or other exception after Popen can enter main finally and run post_guard while a graph descendant continues. sudo/timeout may also create a different process group, so killing the outer sudo group alone is not a proven descendant stop.
must_fix.required: Wrap Popen lifecycle in its own finally; terminate/reap the actual traced build process tree on every abnormal exit and verify no process remains before post-guard. Keep GNU timeout as the bounded primary mechanism and record its actual terminal state.

must_fix.problem: Trace checks executable basenames after execution and captures only execve/execveat. Direct clone/clone3/unshare/setns namespace operations are not observed. A forbidden executable could already have run before RESULT rejects it. A generated Soong Ninja file may contain nsjail actions even though --skip-ninja does not run them.
must_fix.required: Before dispatch, statically close the bootstrap/soong-only package argv to disallowed launchers; fail closed on complete execution trace and relevant namespace syscalls. Report generated-action audit separately and do not authorize target Ninja from this graph result.

must_fix.problem: Failures before CONTROL.mkdir leave no RESULT; status GRAPH_COMMAND_TERMINAL and exit 0 can follow any build.*.ninja file without checking it is the fixed aosp_arm64 graph or that Android.bp.list is nonempty and covers the admitted full TOP. Result unconditionally states zero target compile commands rather than deriving that from the trace; it has no separate graph-pass field.
must_fix.required: Emit a fail-closed preflight receipt even if preparation fails, require the expected product-specific Ninja artifact and nonempty full-tree BP list, and distinguish observed graph command rc from graph evidence, target compilation and generated action safety.
